description: Query actual lead records by an instance-supported filter_type and up to 300 filter_values. Read describe_lead_fields.searchable_fields first to discover valid standard and custom filter types. Optional fields restrict returned columns. A non-empty next_page_token is authoritative: more_result is normalized from token presence, so continue even when Marketo's raw moreResult flag says false.
embedding_description: Fetch Marketo lead and person records by matching an instance-supported standard or custom field against up to 300 values, optionally selecting returned columns and draining all matching pages through their continuation tokens.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with records (a list of lead field-value dicts) + row_count + spilled=false inline, OR result_blob_key + row_count + spilled=true when large, plus next_page_token and more_result. For get_leads, more_result is normalized from whether a non-empty continuation token is present.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Summarize the row_count and show a few lead records. If more_result is true, the query is INCOMPLETE and must continue with next_page_token; token presence is authoritative even when Marketo's raw moreResult flag was false.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Query leads by filter from the configured Marketo instance.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: missing filter_type/filter_values, more than 300 values, or Marketo rejected a filter_type that is not searchable on this instance. marketo.object_not_found: no leads matched the filter (Marketo code 702). marketo.auth_failed: OAuth credentials rejected. marketo.permission_denied: the API user's Role lacks Read-Only/Read-Write Person. marketo.partition_access_denied: the API user isn't assigned to the workspace/partition these leads live in. marketo.rate_limited: API rate limit exceeded.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.invalid_params: read describe_lead_fields.searchable_fields and use an exact returned field name. marketo.object_not_found: confirm the filter_type/filter_values actually match a lead. marketo.rate_limited: retry after a short delay. marketo.auth_failed: ask the operator to check the OAuth client_id/client_secret. marketo.permission_denied / marketo.partition_access_denied: run check_setup to see the exact gap and which admin screen fixes it.
